sources.note: Static eval of Public.com API free tier via live-proven a-canary/Trading integration (src/brokers/public). No new live probe (secret key absent from eval env).

body.verdict_reason: Free-tier clears zero-cost gate: marketdata scope is a free dashboard toggle, not a paid entitlement. Quotes + option-chain + portfolio usable on existing credential path.
body.options_flow_caveat: API exposes option-CHAIN snapshots (per-contract bid/ask/last/OI), not an order-flow feed. Slice-2 must capture chain snapshots and derive flow (open-interest deltas; chain payload carries no per-contract volume) downstream; no single flow endpoint exists.
